header.title: Number of notifiable infectious diseases
tablenote: Number of notified cases refers to notifications of infectious disease cases known to the Department of Health as of 11 May 2026. Up-to-date figures are available at the website of the Centre for Health Protection (www.chp.gov.hk).  The figures are provisional and would be revised based on updated information.
A revised case definition of 'Botulism' has been adopted since May 2016.

'Melioidosis' has been listed as a notifiable infectious disease since 11 November 2022. The figures of 'Melioidosis' from 1 January to 10 November 2022 were based on the notifications from Hospital Authority according to the month of laboratory confirmation.
'Mpox (Monkeypox)' has been listed as a notifiable infectious disease since 10 June 2022.

'Novel influenza A infection' has been listed as a notifiable infectious disease since 21 February 2014, which has replaced 'Influenza A (H2)', 'Variant influenza A (H3N2)', 'Influenza A (H5)', 'Influenza A (H7)' and 'Influenza A (H9)'.

'Severe Respiratory Disease associated with a Novel Infectious Agent' has been listed as a notifiable infectious disease since 8 January 2020 and renamed as 'COVID-19' since 29 April 2020. In January 2022, the Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health revised the figures of 'COVID-19' according to the date of reporting of the cases.
